cover: Enterprise architecture diagram on deep Salesforce navy (#032D60) background with subtle dot-grid. Bright Salesforce sky-blue (#00A1E0) glowing header: 'Release Architecture for 50 Salesforce Developers'. Subtitle in white: 'Branching, CI gates, metadata ownership, sandbox flow, and release trains in one org'. Top-right: circular avatar badge 'Bennie Joseph | Architect'. THREE BRIGHT LAYERS with glowing rounded borders: TOP LAYER 'Developer Flow' vivid cyan/blue border — modules 'Feature Branches', 'Scratch Orgs', 'PR Validation' as bright white pill badges with micro git icons. MID LAYER 'Release Control' vivid purple border — modules 'Trunk', 'Package Domains', 'Regression Gates' as bright white pills. BOTTOM LAYER 'Enterprise Runtime' vivid teal/green border — modules 'Sales Cloud', 'Service Cloud', 'Agentforce 2.0' as bright white pills. Central glowing node: 'Release Train' in Salesforce sky-blue circle with lightning bolt icon, bright dotted connector arrows flowing to all layers. RIGHT PANEL orange border: 'Data Migration Windows' and 'External Integration Freeze'. BOTTOM STRIP teal background: 'Governance Loop' → 'Own Metadata' → 'Validate Impact' → 'Deploy Safely' with flow arrows. Salesforce cloud watermark very subtle bottom-left. High contrast, sharp rendering, publication-ready.
